{{Quote|So what's the story on this Dean Jinzler?''"<br />"''He's a middle-age man, somewhere in his sixties. Quite intelligent, though he's apparently never made much of a name for himself in any profession or system. He traveled around quite a bit during the Clone Wars, though the details of his activities are sketchy. He joined the organization about a year ago with certificates in comm tech, droid maintenance, and hyperdrive tech.''"<br />"''Impressive credentials. Doesn't sound like the sort of person you'd stick in an Outer Rim Dead Zone station.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker]] and [[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dead Zone''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler's]] term to describe a particularly empty and lifeless stretch of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. This area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Comra/Legends|Comra]].<ref name="CSWE" />
